name: How long does it take to complete a room addition project?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete a room addition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for a room addition project varies greatly depending on its size, complexity, and local permitting requirements. Small additions might take 3-6 months from design to completion, while larger, more complex projects could extend to 9-12 months or longer. A significant portion of this time is often dedicated to securing necessary permits from city planning departments in areas like Daly City or South San Francisco. We provide a detailed project schedule after the design phase is complete.
acceptedAnswer.description: Project timelines vary by size and complexity, typically ranging from 3-12 months. Permit acquisition is a key factor.
